content.title: How to watch Sidemen Charity Match 2026 for free - TV channel, live stream, kick-off time
content.text: SportFootballSidemen Charity MatchNeed to knowThe annual Sidemen charity fixture takes place this weekendThe Sidemen Charity Match returns on Saturday(Image: PA)All you need to know about how to watch the 2026 edition of the Sidemen charity match:When it's taking place: The Sidemen Charity Match 2026 is officially scheduled for this Saturday, April 18, at the iconic Wembley Stadium. This massive event, featuring Sidemen FC vs YouTube All-Stars, returns to the home of English football after a record-breaking sell-out saw 90,000 tickets sold in under two hours.How to watch: The most important thing for fans at home is that you can watch the entire event for free on the official Sidemen YouTube channel. There is no pay-per-view cost or subscription required, though you should be wary of third-party sites asking for credit card details to view the stream.Finding the game online: While the match will not be broadcast on traditional terrestrial TV channels like the BBC or ITV, you can easily watch it on your television using the YouTube app. Simply search for "Sidemen" on your smart TV or console to find the live broadcast, which will be pinned to the top of their channel.Kick-off time: The official kick-off is 3:00pm, though the pre-match show usually begins about an hour earlier. You will want to tune in by 2:00pm to catch the player arrivals, warm-ups, and the always-entertaining opening ceremony performances.A twist for 2026: In a massive twist this year, the Sidemen have split their own ranks, with three members joining the opposition for the first time. This shake-up means the usual chemistry is out the window, and the competitive stakes are higher than ever.The Sidemen team: Managed by Jack Joseph, the Sidemen outfit will feature Deji, Marlon Zerkaa, Arthur TV, Aminematue, ChrisMD, xQc Adapt, Jynxzi, TBJZL Niko and AB. The team will be completed by the likes of AJ Shabeel, LazarBeam, Lacy, Wroetoshaw and Vikkstar123The YouTube All-Stars team: YouTube The YouTube All-Stars will be coached by Calfreezy and will feature Sketch, KSI, CarryMinati, Miniminter, George Clarkey Ibai and AngryGinge. Making up their team is Squeezie, MrWhoseTheBoss, Nykchazza, Fanum, Behzinga, Danny Aarons, Stable Ronaldo, El Rubius, ItalianBach and Jasontheween.A good cause: Last year's game raised over £4.7million for charity after tickets sold out in just three hours, with proceeds going to Bright Side and M7 Education.
